-- Generated by scripts/generateHotelsData.js
-- Total hotels: 5000

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hotels (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  hotel_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  city TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL,
  address TEXT NOT NULL,
  latitude NUMERIC(9,6) NOT NULL,
  longitude NUMERIC(9,6) NOT NULL,
  star_rating INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (star_rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  review_score NUMERIC(2,1) NOT NULL CHECK (review_score BETWEEN 3.0 AND 5.0),
  review_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (review_count >= 0),
  price_per_night INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (price_per_night BETWEEN 800 AND 25000),
  category TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('Budget', 'Standard', 'Premium', 'Luxury')),
  amenities TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  image_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  phone TEXT NOT NULL,
  email TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hotels_city ON hotels(city);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hotels_lat_lng ON hotels(latitude, longitude);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hotels_price ON hotels(price_per_night);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hotels_category ON hotels(category);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hotels (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  hotel_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  city TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL,
  address TEXT NOT NULL,
  latitude NUMERIC(9,6) NOT NULL,
  longitude NUMERIC(9,6) NOT NULL,
  star_rating INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (star_rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  review_score NUMERIC(2,1) NOT NULL CHECK (review_score BETWEEN 3.0 AND 5.0),
  review_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (review_count >= 0),
  price_per_night INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (price_per_night BETWEEN 800 AND 25000),
  category TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('Budget', 'Standard', 'Premium', 'Luxury')),
  amenities TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  image_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  phone TEXT NOT NULL,
  email TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hotels_city ON hotels(city);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hotels_lat_lng ON hotels(latitude, longitude);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hotels_price ON hotels(price_per_night);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hotels_category ON hotels(category);
